limitations: The analysis is exploratory after A2 on the already known E1 calendar, not restored prospective confirmation.
One BTC series and fixed fitted trajectories; no market-population or HPO-selection uncertainty.
Moving-block inference is approximate under suitable weak dependence/local stationarity;14 days is not universally adequate.
Only six optimization pairs inform dz; its bootstrap can be unstable and undefined samples are disclosed.
No demonstrated RQ2-specific power; non-rejection does not establish robustness or equivalence.
A causal regime available at issue time is distinct from grouping by realized same-day target.
Only six covarying configurations and one optimization seed per fold; parameter effects are confounded.
The same validation folds selected the winner; performance curves do not estimate selection uncertainty or external generalization.
The lost T4 session retains unknown scientific outcome and conservative budget charge, never reconstructed metrics or optimizer steps.
Failed configurations retain their available fold scores but are ineligible for pooled selection.
Recorded applicable dimensions may remain fixed; this inventory does not close missing search breadth or family-specific minima.
Current campaign charges, original cached-fit cost and phase elapsed have different scopes and must not be added indiscriminately.
